details: Bitcoin briefly fell below $65,000, and major altcoins like Ethereum, XRP, and Solana also experienced declines following a hawkish message from the Federal Reserve Chair. The Fed kept rates unchanged but signaled a stronger tightening bias, weakening risk appetite across financial markets and pushing the Crypto Fear & Greed Index into "Extreme Fear" territory. Total liquidations in the crypto market reached $439 million in the past 24 hours, with long liquidations dominating at $307 million.
title: Crypto Markets Decline Amid Hawkish Fed Stance

details: A Bloomberg senior commodity strategist cautioned that the proposed CLARITY Act, while beneficial for stablecoins and tokenized assets, could lead to "millions of cryptos tracking nothing" dropping to zero. The bill is moving with unusual urgency, with a White House target for passage by July 4, aiming to legitimize assets with genuine utility and accelerate the obsolescence of purely speculative tokens.
title: Bloomberg Analyst Warns CLARITY Act May Zero Out Many Cryptos

details: CryptoQuant reported that Bitcoin microtransactions now account for 80% of daily transactions. This surge suggests increasing utility and adoption for smaller value transfers on the Bitcoin network.
title: Bitcoin Microtransactions Hit 80% of Daily Transactions

details: Ethereum's significant "Glamsterdam" upgrade has entered its final stage of development. This upgrade includes key improvements like ePBS (EIP-7732), Block-Level Access Lists (EIP-7928), and a repricing of the gas fee structure, reinforcing Ethereum's role as a modular settlement layer. Mainnet deployment is anticipated in the second half of 2026.
title: Ethereum's "Glamsterdam" Upgrade Nears Mainnet Deployment

details: CME Group has filed a lawsuit against the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) regarding the approval of perpetual futures contracts in the U.S. This legal action highlights ongoing regulatory battles and uncertainty surrounding derivatives trading in the crypto space.
title: CME Group Sues CFTC Over Perpetual Futures Approval

details: Fidelity Investments has officially launched the Fidelity Reserves Digital Fund, with State Street also entering the market, to provide compliant reserve asset management services for stablecoin issuers and institutional investors. This move signals increasing institutional participation and legitimization within the stablecoin ecosystem.
title: Fidelity, State Street Launch Stablecoin Reserve Management Funds
